claims.text: Cac can thiep trong benh vien nham giam thoi gian nam vien/tai nhap vien o DTD type 2 da duoc tong hop trong 1 SR, nhung khong co so lieu gop ro va nhieu tieu chi AMSTAR 2 trong yeu khong xac dinh duoc tu abstract.

HbA1c luc nhap vien cao hon co the lien quan voi tang nguy co tai nhap vien trong 30-31 ngay o DTD type 2 (aOR 1,15 moi 1% HbA1c, KTC 95% 1,03-1,29; HbA1c la 1 trong 6 bien du bao trong mot nomogram khac); bang chung giai tiep vi moc thoi gian ngan hon 1 nam.

Chua ro lieu chieu huong lien quan giua HbA1c va tai nhap vien co phu thuoc vao thoi diem do HbA1c (luc nhap vien vs sau xuat vien) hay khong; HbA1c sau xuat vien thap hon lai lien quan tang tai nhap vien trong mot nghien cuu khac (Cohen's D 0,28, hieu ung nho).

O moc 365 ngay, yeu to du bao tai nhap vien o DTD type 2 co the chuyen tu yeu to cap tinh sang bien chung man tinh dac hieu DTD theo mot mo hinh hoc may (SHAP); mo hinh nay khong tach rieng hieu ung doc lap cua HbA1c.

Chua co nghien cuu do dung phoi nhiem (HbA1c luc nhap vien) + dung outcome (tai nhap vien moi nguyen nhan) + dung moc thoi gian (1 nam) o DTD type 2 noi chung; muc do tin cay GRADE so bo = rat thap (very low).

ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026, muc 16, khuyen cao kiem soat duong huyet noi vien va lap ke hoach xuat vien/chuyen tiep cham soc noi chung; khong doc full-text nen khong trich mot nguong HbA1c cu the tu guideline nay.

Chua tim thay nghien cuu thuc hien tai Viet Nam ve HbA1c luc nhap vien va tai nhap vien o DTD type 2 trong phien tim kiem PubMed da thuc hien; tap chi tieng Viet chua duoc tim trong phien nay (han che, khong phai ket luan 'khong co').
